description: This file defines the 'Value' class which provides various static methods for evaluating and checking different types and properties of values, including functions like isBlank, isRef, isEven, isOdd, isNumber, isLogical, isText, isNonText, isFormula, asNumber, and type within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: A class providing static methods for evaluating and checking value types in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if a value or array of values is blank (null).

methods.name: isRef
methods.description: Checks if a value is a valid cell reference or named range.

methods.name: isEven
methods.description: Checks if a numeric value is even.

methods.name: isOdd
methods.description: Checks if a numeric value is odd.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is numeric.

methods.name: isLogical
methods.description: Checks if a value is a boolean logical value.

methods.name: isText
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string and not an error.

methods.name: isNonText
methods.description: Checks if a value is not text.

methods.name: isFormula
methods.description: Checks if a cell reference points to a cell containing a formula.

methods.name: asNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a number, following specific conversion rules.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns a number representing the data type of a value.
